headline.title: How Deutsche Telekom is rewiring telecommunications with AI
headline.summary: Deutsche Telekom is integrating AI technologies to enhance customer service, streamline employee workflows, and optimize network operations. The company aims to become an AI-native telecommunications provider, leveraging innovations from OpenAI to transform its services.

articles.title: Value generalisation: value correction
articles.summary: The article discusses the concept of value generalization in AI alignment, emphasizing its importance for ensuring that AI systems can correct their reward functions when they are found to be incorrect. It presents a specific reinforcement learning example where an agent recognizes and adjusts its understanding of the true reward based on human demonstrations.

articles.title: Robot Dogs, Teslas, and Rescue Helicopters: The UN AI Summit Was a Lot
articles.summary: The UN's AI for Good summit addressed the challenges of global governance in the face of rapidly advancing AI technologies, featuring discussions on various applications including robot dogs and rescue helicopters. Experts emphasized the need for regulatory frameworks to keep pace with AI developments to ensure safety and ethical use.

articles.title: Microsoft’s carbon emissions went up 25 percent last year
articles.summary: Microsoft's carbon emissions rose by 25 percent in 2025, reaching a total of 34 million metric tons, according to its 2026 sustainability report. The increase was attributed mainly to the company's expansion efforts, which hindered its ability to meet climate goals.

articles.title: OpenAI says GPT 5.6 is the ‘preferred model’ for Microsoft Copilot 365 amid breakup chatter
articles.summary: OpenAI has announced that GPT 5.6 will be the preferred model for Microsoft Copilot 365, ensuring its integration into Microsoft's suite of workplace and productivity applications. This development comes amid ongoing discussions about the future of the partnership between OpenAI and Microsoft.

articles.title: Fidji Simo steps down from OpenAI’s no. 2 role
articles.summary: Fidji Simo has resigned from her position as OpenAI's No. 2 executive after an extended medical leave. Her departure creates a leadership gap for the company as it prepares for a potential IPO and competes with Anthropic in the enterprise sector.

articles.title: Profiling in PyTorch (Part 3): Attention is all you profile
articles.summary: The article discusses the importance of profiling attention mechanisms in PyTorch to optimize performance in deep learning models. It provides insights into various profiling techniques and tools that can help developers identify bottlenecks and improve the efficiency of their code.

articles.title: OpenAI launches its new family of models with GPT-5.6
articles.summary: OpenAI has launched its new family of models, featuring GPT-5.6, which includes enhancements aimed at various applications, notably in cybersecurity. The updates are designed to improve performance and functionality across multiple domains.

articles.title: An AI agent startup just let its agent run its $100M fundraise
articles.summary: Lyzr, a startup specializing in AI agents for enterprises, successfully utilized its own AI agent to secure a $100 million fundraising round. This achievement demonstrates the effectiveness of its product in real-world applications.

articles.title: Can AI answer the $3 trillion question?
articles.summary: The article discusses the ongoing debate surrounding the return on investment (ROI) of artificial intelligence, highlighting the potential economic impact estimated at $3 trillion. It examines the implications of AI adoption and the challenges in quantifying its financial benefits.

articles.title: GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model in Microsoft 365 Copilot
articles.summary: Microsoft has integrated GPT-5.6 into its 365 Copilot, enhancing AI capabilities across applications like Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. This update aims to improve efficiency and output quality for users.

articles.title: Patch for Windows Defender 0-day could allow attackers to fill hard disk
articles.summary: A patch has been released for a Windows Defender 0-day vulnerability that could allow attackers to fill a hard disk. The ongoing conflict between the security researcher NightmareEclipse and Microsoft continues as the issue remains unresolved.
